nodes.name: Every Five Minutes
nodes.notes: Orders, then the money behind them. They are two different events, days apart, so they are read separately and joined by order id.

nodes.name: Open Rooms
nodes.notes: Which shops are live right now. An order placed on an account while that account is streaming is a live sale, and is filed against the stream rather than the shopfront.

nodes.name: Normalise Orders
nodes.notes: A status nobody mapped falls back to UNPAID, which is the safe end: an order that is really paid will say so on the next sweep, whereas guessing PAID would ship a parcel against no money.

nodes.name: Record The Order
nodes.notes: The backend decides from the floor’s own rule whether this is the moment the stock leaves the shelf. 423 means the floor is suspended.

nodes.name: Every Morning
nodes.notes: Payouts settle overnight on all three. Reconciling them once a day is enough, and it keeps the signed call count down.

nodes.name: Reconcile It
nodes.notes: The backend compares the transfer against the orders in it and marks the payout SHORT with the figure if they disagree by more than the floor’s tolerance.

nodes.name: Every Half Hour
nodes.notes: The Payment Collector’s round: orders that were placed and never paid for.

nodes.name: What Is Overdue
nodes.notes: The floor’s own rule decides what counts as overdue: how long to wait before a nudge, and how long before the order is given up on.

nodes.name: File A Nudge
nodes.notes: Filed for approval like every other line that reaches a customer, and only once per order however many times this runs.
